    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=next(v for v,n in counts.most_common() if v!=bg and n>1)
    # The exemplar is the three-cell line made from the other non-background cells.
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,marker)]
    # Select an aligned run of three non-background cells, excluding the marker.
    exemplar=None
    for r,c in pts:
        for dr,dc in ((0,1),(1,0)):
            run=[(r+i*dr,c+i*dc) for i in range(3)]
            if all(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc] not in (bg,marker) for rr,cc in run):
                exemplar=[(grid[rr][cc],rr-r,cc-c) for rr,cc in run]; break
        if exemplar: break
    if exemplar is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Align the marker to the distinctive anchor: middle cell when all three differ,
    # otherwise the singleton color in a repeated/repeated/singleton motif.
    vals=[x[0] for x in exemplar]
    if len(set(vals))==3: anchor=1
    else: anchor=next(i for i,v in enumerate(vals) if vals.count(v)==1)
    ar,ac=exemplar[anchor][1:]
    offsets=[(v,rr-ar,cc-ac) for v,rr,cc in exemplar]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==marker:
                for v,dr,dc in offsets:
                    rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n = len(grid)
    # Find the color-5 rectangular frame and the two colored markers outside it.
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(n))]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(n) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    markers.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    a, b = markers[0][2], markers[1][2]
    # Markers above the frame map left-to-right across the top; below map across the bottom.
    below = all(r > bottom for r, c, v in markers)
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            upper = r < (top + bottom) / 2
            left_half = c < (left + right) / 2
            if below:
                color = (b if upper else a) if left_half else (a if upper else b)
            else:
                color = (a if upper else b) if left_half else (b if upper else a)
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
